added.explanation: The source says 리자드, which the glossary distinguishes from 리자드맨 (Lizardman).
added.korean: 누가 보면 리자드 성애자인 줄 알겠다.

decisions.reason: Choi later says only he and Taekyung will enter (우리 둘이 전붑니다), so his answer points to Taekyung as the teammate already present, not to other people.

summary: The teammate reference should address Taekyung, and one distinct creature term was mistranslated.
